tool.title: Name the workflows a site publish waits for on the same commit
tool.description: Print the repository's workflows that a site publish must wait for, on the same commit, before it builds: every workflow that calls a reusable workflow a declared site publisher names in `after` (for example an IG's AST refresh, which seeds the cache the site is built from), plus `site.publishAfter` from `index.config.json`. A workflow that calls the shared site publish is never named: it is the publish itself. The shared `folio-site-publish.yml` runs it and then waits for each workflow it names.

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: The repository checkout whose workflows to read. Default: the current directory.

outputs.name: workflows
outputs.description: The workflow file names to wait for, space-separated on one line; empty when there is none.
